Tappa — Aerocity, New Delhi (2018).

Packaging and identity for a Delhi eatery — a kraft-paper system sealed with a navy-and-red mark. Salad boxes with a window to the food, takeaway cups, folded sandwich boxes, each closed with the Tappa stamp. Eco, est. 2018 — passionately Delhi.
